name: has_role
label: Directory role
description: A role held by the subject, such as Global Administrator.
interpretation: One person can hold several roles. Match the exact observed role name.

name: account_enabled
label: Account enabled
description: Whether the directory reports the account enabled.
interpretation: Enabled does not prove the person can successfully sign in or that access is appropriate.

name: last_sign_in
label: Last interactive sign-in
description: When the identity source reports the last interactive sign-in.
interpretation: A fresh collection can report an old sign-in. Do not substitute a different vendor authentication event.

name: last_non_interactive_sign_in
label: Last non-interactive sign-in
description: When the source reports the last non-interactive sign-in.
interpretation: Background activity is different from a person actively signing in.

name: user_type
label: User type
description: The type of directory user reported by the source.
interpretation: Use actual source values when distinguishing members and guests.

name: directory_synced
label: Directory synchronised
description: Whether the account is reported as synchronised from another directory.
interpretation: This describes its directory origin, not the health of the whole synchronisation service.

name: mfa_registered
label: MFA registered
description: Whether the user has registered multi-factor authentication.
interpretation: Registration does not establish enforcement on every sign-in.

name: sspr_registered
label: Password reset registered
description: Whether self-service password reset registration is reported.
interpretation: Registration does not prove every recovery path is configured safely.

name: member_of
label: Group membership
description: A group the subject belongs to.
interpretation: Membership can have several values. Review which group is actually relevant.

name: mfa_method
label: Registered MFA method
description: A second-factor method associated with the subject.
interpretation: Several methods can coexist; a strong method does not erase a weaker one.

name: mfa_bypass_enabled
label: MFA bypass enabled
description: Whether the MFA source reports bypass enabled for the user.
interpretation: A bypass setting is a separate observation from having registered a factor.

name: has_licence
label: Licence or entitlement
description: A licence associated with the subject.
interpretation: The subject may be a user or a company. Assignment and purchased entitlement are different contexts.

name: licence_seats_purchased
label: Purchased seats
description: The reported number of purchased or entitled seats for a product.
interpretation: Compare like-for-like products and subjects; it is not a count of active users.

name: licence_seats_assigned
label: Assigned seats
description: The reported number of seats assigned for a product.
interpretation: Assigned seats do not prove active usage or contractual entitlement.

name: licence_renewal_date
label: Next licence renewal
description: The reported next renewal date for a product commitment.
interpretation: A date, not an assurance that cancellation or quantity changes remain possible.

name: ca_policy_scope
label: Policy scope
description: The normalised scope reported for a Conditional Access policy.
interpretation: Inspect the policy context; a scope label is not proof that every relevant sign-in is protected.

name: ca_policy_state
label: Policy state
description: Whether and how a Conditional Access policy is enabled, as reported by the source.
interpretation: Report-only and enforced behaviour differ. Compare actual state values.

name: ca_policy_grant_controls
label: Policy grant requirements
description: The grant controls configured on a Conditional Access policy.
interpretation: A policy can contain several controls. Their presence alone does not prove effective coverage.

name: ca_policy_modified_at
label: Policy last changed
description: When the source reports the policy was modified.
interpretation: A timestamp establishes timing, not authorisation or the safety of the change.

name: ca_policy_last_modified_by
label: Policy changed by
description: The reported actor associated with the policy modification.
interpretation: An actor identity is not itself approval evidence.

name: policy_scope_narrowed
label: Policy scope reduced
description: An observation that the policy scope narrowed.
interpretation: Review the affected scope and approved change context before deciding whether the change is wrong.

name: mailbox_type
label: Mailbox type
description: The type of mailbox reported by the source.
interpretation: Use it to distinguish mailbox kinds, not to infer security configuration. Microsoft Partner Center delegated connections do not supply this evidence; use a Direct Microsoft application connection with mailbox access.

name: mailbox_timezone
label: Mailbox time zone
description: The time zone configured for the mailbox.
interpretation: This is a mailbox setting; Alignr evidence timestamps remain UTC. Microsoft Partner Center delegated connections do not supply this evidence; use a Direct Microsoft application connection with mailbox access.

name: mailbox_auto_reply
label: Automatic reply setting
description: The automatic-reply setting reported for the mailbox.
interpretation: Interpret the source value; it does not prove a message was delivered. Microsoft Partner Center delegated connections do not supply this evidence; use a Direct Microsoft application connection with mailbox access.

name: verified_domain
label: Verified directory domain
description: A domain verified in the source tenant.
interpretation: Domain ownership verification does not establish mail protection or DNS policy correctness.

name: default_domain
label: Default directory domain
description: The default domain reported by the directory.
interpretation: A default designation is different from the complete set of verified domains.

name: domain_auth_type
label: Domain authentication type
description: The authentication type reported for the directory domain.
interpretation: Review its actual source value and policy context before drawing an access conclusion.

name: device_managed_by
label: Device management
description: The reported management relationship for an endpoint.
interpretation: RMM management is different from MDM enrolment and EDR protection.

name: device_last_checkin
label: Last management check-in
description: When the device last reported to the management source.
interpretation: Compare the event time with your reporting expectation, and check when it was collected.

name: device_online
label: Device online
description: Whether the source reports the device online.
interpretation: Online does not imply patched, encrypted or free of threats.

name: os_platform
label: Operating system
description: The reported operating-system platform.
interpretation: Match actual normalised values; a platform name alone does not prove a supported version.

name: patch_status
label: Patch state
description: The patching state reported by the management source.
interpretation: Datto's `unknown` is missing evidence, not a pass or failure. A complete, validated inventory that omits patch status withdraws Datto's previous observation; an incomplete inventory leaves that observation subject to freshness rules.

name: patches_pending
label: Pending patch count
description: The source-reported number of pending patches.
interpretation: A zero count is meaningful within the reporting source’s scope, not proof of a complete vulnerability scan.

name: antivirus_product
label: Antivirus product
description: The antivirus product reported on the endpoint.
interpretation: Product presence does not establish protection health or recent updates.

name: agent_health
label: Management agent health
description: The reported health of the endpoint management agent.
interpretation: This is distinct from the health of an EDR agent.

name: edr_agent_installed
label: EDR installed
description: Whether the source reports endpoint detection and response agent installation.
interpretation: Check health and check-in evidence separately.

name: edr_agent_health
label: EDR health
description: The EDR source’s reported agent-health state.
interpretation: Read the actual state and source; installed, healthy and recently seen are separate questions.

name: edr_last_checkin
label: Last EDR check-in
description: When the EDR agent last reported activity.
interpretation: Use the event timestamp as well as evidence freshness.

name: edr_agent_version
label: EDR version
description: The reported EDR agent version.
interpretation: A version string needs a supported-version expectation before it can establish alignment.

name: edr_policy_group
label: EDR policy group
description: The policy group reported for the EDR agent.
interpretation: Group membership does not prove the effective policy settings are correct.

name: threat_detected
label: Reported threat
description: An individual threat observation, such as its classification.
interpretation: Multiple threats can exist. Review the source record before interpreting severity or current status.

name: threat_open_count
label: Open threat count
description: The source’s per-device count of open threats.
interpretation: A vendor rollup can differ from counting individual fact rows; do not silently equate them.

name: vulnerability_detected
label: Reported vulnerability
description: An individual vulnerability observation associated with the subject.
interpretation: There may be several findings; check the identifier and source context.

name: vulnerability_max_severity
label: Highest vulnerability severity
description: The highest reported severity band for the subject.
interpretation: A severity band is not a count, and does not describe every finding.

name: vulnerability_open_count
label: Open vulnerability count
description: The source-reported count of open vulnerabilities.
interpretation: Scanner scope and counting methods differ; avoid adding unlike rollups together.

name: missing_patch
label: Missing patch
description: An individual patch reported missing from the subject.
interpretation: Several patches can be missing. This differs from the total pending-patch count.

name: network_device_role
label: Network device role
description: A role the device performs, such as switching or wireless access.
interpretation: One appliance can have several roles.

name: network_device_model
label: Hardware model
description: The reported network-device model.
interpretation: Model identity does not establish firmware support or configuration safety.

name: network_device_firmware
label: Firmware version
description: The reported network-device firmware version.
interpretation: Compare with the relevant expectation for that device and source.

name: network_device_ip
label: Management address
description: The reported network-device IP address.
interpretation: An address is not evidence that the device is publicly reachable.

name: network_device_uplink
label: Upstream connection
description: The reported upstream connection for a network device.
interpretation: Use it as topology evidence, not a complete network diagram.

name: firmware_update_available
label: Firmware update available
description: Whether the source reports an available firmware update.
interpretation: Availability is distinct from approval, urgency and safe scheduling.

name: vpn_tunnel
label: VPN tunnel membership
description: A reported VPN tunnel or topology relationship.
interpretation: Several tunnels can exist. Membership alone does not prove current tunnel health.

name: network_segment_type
label: Network segment type
description: The reported type of a network segment, such as a VLAN or routed network.
interpretation: The presence of a VLAN does not prove isolation between networks.

name: firewall_policy_count
label: Firewall rule count
description: The reported number of firewall policies.
interpretation: A count cannot prove which traffic is allowed or whether the rulebase is safe.

name: firewall_l3_rules_fingerprint
label: Firewall rule fingerprint
description: A versioned fingerprint of supported Layer 3 rule configuration.
interpretation: A changed fingerprint shows configuration identity changed; it does not establish approval or safety.

name: remote_access_resource
label: Accessible resource
description: A remote-access resource associated with a group.
interpretation: A group can reach several resources. Combine with relevant membership evidence when reviewing access.

name: remote_access_address
label: Resource destination
description: The address reported for a remote-access resource.
interpretation: A destination is distinct from the users and groups entitled to reach it.

name: mdm_enrolled_by
label: MDM enrolment
description: The management product in which the device is enrolled.
interpretation: Co-management can produce several valid enrolments; enrolment alone is not compliance.

name: device_compliance_state
label: MDM compliance state
description: The device-compliance result reported by the MDM source.
interpretation: This reflects that source’s policy evaluation, not every Alignr control.

name: device_encryption_enabled
label: Device encryption
description: Whether the management source reports encryption enabled.
interpretation: This does not prove recovery-key availability or successful recovery.

name: policy_baseline_state
label: Baseline state
description: The reported state of a managed policy baseline.
interpretation: Normalised states include enforced, not_applied, drifted and error. Unknown source states must not be guessed.

name: mail_protected_by
label: Mail protection provider
description: A mail security gateway reported for the domain.
interpretation: Several providers can coexist during migration; provider presence is not proof of every protection.

name: mail_protection_feature
label: Mail protection feature
description: A reported protection feature for the mail domain.
interpretation: Several features can coexist. Check the feature and source rather than assuming full mail security.

name: external_spf_present
label: SPF record present
description: Whether the bounded DNS check observed an SPF record for the approved target.
interpretation: Presence is not a full SPF correctness or deliverability assessment.

name: external_dmarc_enforced
label: DMARC enforcement policy
description: Whether the DNS check reports an enforcing DMARC policy for the approved target.
interpretation: A policy observation does not establish message alignment or delivery outcomes.

name: external_mx_present
label: Mail routing records present
description: Whether MX records were observed for the approved domain.
interpretation: MX presence does not prove that a mailbox exists or mail will be accepted.

name: external_nameserver_count
label: Name server count
description: The number of name servers reported by the DNS check.
interpretation: A count does not prove independent hosting or resilience.

name: monitored_system
label: Monitored system
description: A system reported by the configuration-monitoring source.
interpretation: Being listed does not establish successful or recent inspection.

name: inspection_status
label: Inspection state
description: The reported state of a configuration inspection.
interpretation: Read the actual source state alongside the inspection time.

name: inspection_last_run_at
label: Last inspection
description: When the source reports its last inspection run.
interpretation: A recent run timestamp is different from a successful result.

name: leaver_ticket
label: Leaver ticket
description: A ticket associated with an offboarding process.
interpretation: A ticket’s existence does not establish that all access has been removed.

name: leaver_ticket_status
label: Leaver ticket state
description: The reported state of an offboarding ticket.
interpretation: A closed ticket is workflow evidence, not proof that directory access is disabled.

name: ticket_closed_at
label: Ticket closure time
description: When the source reports a ticket was closed.
interpretation: Use it for timing; verify the technical outcome separately.

name: ticket_contains_secret
label: Secret-in-ticket signal
description: An observation that ticket content contains a secret.
interpretation: The signal is not an instruction to publish or retrieve the secret itself.

name: secret_reuse_count
label: Secret reuse count
description: A reported count associated with reuse of a credential.
interpretation: Interpret within the producer’s scope. The count does not reveal the credential value.

name: change_ticket_ref
label: Change ticket reference
description: A change-ticket reference associated with the subject.
interpretation: Several references may exist. A reference alone is not evidence of approval.

name: ticket_status
label: Ticket state
description: The status reported for a general ticket.
interpretation: Use the actual workflow state; similarly named statuses can have different meanings across sources.

name: contract_type
label: Contract type
description: The contract classification reported by the PSA source.
interpretation: A type label does not establish the full terms or technical requirements.

name: backup_protected_by
label: Backup protection provider
description: A product reporting backup protection for the subject.
interpretation: Product presence does not prove a successful backup or a tested restore.

name: backup_last_successful_at
label: Last successful backup
description: When the source reports the last successful backup.
interpretation: Review the relevant job/workload and required recovery-point expectation.

name: backup_job_state
label: Backup job state
description: The source-reported result or state of a backup job.
interpretation: Review the exact normalised state and timing, not the label alone.

name: backup_protected_workload
label: Protected workload
description: A workload associated with a backup job.
interpretation: A job can protect several workloads; membership is distinct from successful recovery.

name: document_references_asset
label: Document asset reference
description: An asset referenced by a retained evidence document.
interpretation: This describes an evidence relationship; it does not make documentation a separate product library.

name: referenced_asset_last_seen
label: Referenced asset last seen
description: When a referenced asset was last observed.
interpretation: Check its producer and observation time before interpreting it as current inventory.

name: referenced_asset_decommissioned
label: Referenced asset retired
description: An observation that a referenced asset is decommissioned.
interpretation: A missing observation does not prove that the asset is still active.

name: certificate_expires_on
label: Certificate expiry
description: The expiry date or time reported for a certificate.
interpretation: Expiry evidence needs its producer and target context; not every integration collects certificates.

name: certificate_issuer
label: Certificate issuer
description: The issuer reported for a certificate.
interpretation: The issuer name alone does not prove trust, validity or correct deployment.
